question.text: A Cat III AIF calculates NAV in WHICH currency?

answer.text: Indian Rupee (INR); investments in other currencies converted at closing market rate on the Valuation Day

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, NAV is computed in INR; non-INR positions converted at closing rate on Valuation Day. The Trap: USD/EUR/SGD are the reporting currencies of specific foreign markets. Cross-Exam Context: Similar rule for MF cross-border holdings (V-A). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Track forex rates for all non-INR holdings at close — avoid intraday rate cherry-picking.
